simulations.title: Two-Body Problem
simulations.description: Simulate the chaotic gravitational interactions of two celestial bodies. Drag to reposition, adjust masses, and watch complex orbital patterns emerge.

simulations.title: Three-Body Effective Potential
simulations.description: Compute instantaneous gravitational potential energy for each body and display the per-body U_eff graph every tick.

simulations.title: Kepler's Orbits
simulations.description: Explore elliptical, parabolic, and hyperbolic orbits around a central mass. Adjust eccentricity and see how orbital shapes change in real-time.
